request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continued development and associated Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests a total of 3,810,423 ADA, consisting of 3,699,440 ADA for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ADA for Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Mithril uses stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way, enabling nodes and applications to verify state rapidly without relying on the entire chain.
The proposer claims full alignment with Infrastructure & Research Excellence and Adoption & Utility, and partial alignment with Community & Ecosystem Growth.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission, on its own or in aggregate, breach the 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Audit and oversight costs are included in the overhead, and independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs, but has worked on Mithril for several years through IOG-funded collaboration.
Intersect will administer funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with listed TRSC and PSSC addresses and external oversight from six named entities.
TRSC and PSSC administrative actions require specified multi-party approvals involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and trusted external entities.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is available for community audit and tracking of this withdrawn ADA, with metrics also immutably verifiable on chain.

summary: The document presents a 3,810,423 ADA treasury withdrawal for Mithril Protocol development through Intersect-administered smart contracts, with stated budget-process approval, NCL compliance, oversight arrangements, and references for external verification.
